visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) Close-up shot of a white bowl containing thinly sliced pink beef in a reddish broth. A metal spoon stirs the meat, lifting several slices to show their texture. Yellow text with a black border is centered on the screen. (2) Exterior shot at night showing a street-side restaurant with a bright yellow awning and red Chinese signage. A man in a black jacket and white shirt stands near the entrance. (3) The man holds a smartphone towards the camera, showing a dark screen with the digital clock reading 3:13. He wears a black windbreaker over a white polo shirt with a small flag emblem. (4) Medium shot of two men standing in front of the restaurant at night. The man on the right wears a brown and beige varsity jacket. They are gesturing and moving their mouths as if speaking. (5) Interior shot of a simple restaurant with stainless steel tables. The two men sit together; the man in the varsity jacket holds a red pen and writes on a paper order form. (6) Close-up of the beef soup again, steam rising visibly from the bowl. The meat appears more cooked and brownish-red. Large yellow subtitles appear at the top. (7) The man in the black jacket takes a spoonful of the soup, his eyes narrowing and head nodding slowly. The man in the varsity jacket watches him intently. (8) Close-up of chopsticks picking up a slice of beef and dipping it into a small white saucer containing a brown sauce and shredded ginger. (9) The man in the varsity jacket eats a large piece of meat, leaning forward with an exaggerated expression of delight and closing his eyes. (10) Wide shot of the restaurant interior showing several other customers, mostly young adults, blurred in the background. The two main men are at a table in the foreground with multiple dishes.

(2) Vocal dialogue shifts to a conversational tone between two males. BGM volume ducks slightly. Faint ambient traffic noise is audible in the background. (4) Sound of paper rustling and a pen scratching, followed by a light 'ding' SFX as a price is mentioned. The BGM beat remains consistent and driving. (5) Wet, splashing sounds of soup being stirred followed by a rhythmic 'hit' SFX on a scene transition. Voices exhibit high arousal and positive valence.
